A_derived_requirement.note: Species-resolved requirement.  Wing datum selects n_e ~ 0.51 n_b0 (p = 0.5) or ~13 n_b0 (exponential) — the earlier '14x' fiducial is recovered as the exponential-branch wing density.  Under p = 0.5 the column z_t -> edge is ~1.7e6 L0, so a continuous electron column is forbidden: the mean electron density there must stay below ~3.7e-04 n_b0 — i.e. the trough medium is derived to be neutral (the Gunn-Peterson saturation IS this requirement).  The '500x' fiducial is recovered as the concentrated front column at the boundary depth (f_wall ~ 400-800 n_b0 over ~1 L0 for Delta_tau ~ 0.9) parametrizing the ionization front, coincident with the Gate-11B dust absorption edge.  Under the exponential branch the wing requires the 14x density and a smooth rise works, but the Gate-11 absorption edge recedes to z ~ 10^197-10^8000; the observed z* ~ 10^3 boundary therefore selects the power-law branch, and the trough-collapse prediction is branch-forced.

B_admissible_profile.morphology: ionized wing -> neutral trough -> ionization front (concentrated-column parametrization)
B_admissible_profile.note: Explicit admissible n_e(ell): f_wing = 0.511 n_b0 out to z = 6, neutral trough (residual x_e = 1e-05) to the boundary depth, and a 500x n_b0 ionization-front column of equivalent thickness 0.84 L0 at z ~ 1080.  The wing column reproduces tau_reion = 0.054 (Planck 0.054), the trough contributes ~zero Thomson depth while the LyC column saturates at 2.4e+10 (the GP trough), and the front column places the tau = 1 surface at z = 1080 — coincident with the absorption edge by construction (the front IS the ionized skin of the Gate-11B opacity boundary: a Strömgren edge in the ambient radiation field, not a material shell).  This is an existence demonstration of a profile satisfying all three points; its profile shape is the datum the population-scale absorber inversion (Part C) must recover.

incidence.note: TEP path Jacobian: at z~3 one dz spans 8 L0 (p=0.5) — the same absorber population maps to ~8x lower incidence per unit path than a Euclidean reading.

lyc_column.note: Observed LLS/sub-LLS systems alone accumulate LyC depth; the diffuse trough column (Part B) dominates by orders of magnitude.

gamma_locus.note: n_b ∝ sqrt(Gamma): the wing requirement n_b ~ f_wing n_b0 selects a maintained UVB level per redshift; the (n_b, Gamma) pair is the degeneracy the Gate-12 emissivity budget and an enlarged catalogue jointly break.

forest_inversion.method: tau_eff(z) = sigma_GP n_HI dL/dz inverts to n_HI(ell); photoionization equilibrium x_HI = alpha_A n_p / Gamma gives n_b = sqrt(Gamma n_HI / alpha_A).

verdict: The three-point opacity requirement is restated in species-resolved form and shown satisfiable: under the canonical p = 0.5 path law an explicit admissible profile (wing n_e ~ 0.51 n_b0 for z <~ 6; neutral trough x_e <~ 1e-4 for z ~ 6-1080; ionization-front column ~500x n_b0 over ~0.8 L0 at the edge) gives tau(z<6) = 0.054 (target 0.054), a saturated trough (tau_LyC ~ 2e+10), and tau = 1 at z = 1080 coincident with the Gate-11B absorption edge.  The trough collapse is a derived necessity of the power-law branch — the Gunn-Peterson saturation IS the requirement, not an extra datum.  The earlier 14x/500x fiducials are recovered as the exponential-branch wing density and the power-law front column respectively.  The pilot inversion demonstrates the absorber-statistics machinery on the in-repo 26-system KODIAQ list; closure at population scale requires an enlarged LLS/forest catalogue.
